problem_statement:
You are working on a FastAPI-based microservice called campaign-service for a Creator Campaign Collaboration Platform (创作者品牌合作平台).

## Task

Implement Settlement & Analytics functionality — payment settlement management and campaign performance analytics.

## Technical Specification

Implement the following components following the existing codebase conventions (see User service as reference):

### Data Models (`app/models/settlement.py`)

**Settlement model:**
- id: String(36), PK, default=generate_uuid
- campaign_id: String(36), NOT NULL
- creator_id: String(36), NOT NULL
- amount: Numeric(12, 2), NOT NULL
- currency: String(3), default="CNY", NOT NULL
- status: Enum(SettlementStatus) with values: pending, processing, completed, failed
- description: String(500), nullable
- processed_at: DateTime(timezone=True), nullable
- Use TimestampMixin and SoftDeleteMixin from app.models.base
- Indexes on campaign_id, creator_id, status

**CampaignAnalytics model:**
- id: String(36), PK, default=generate_uuid
- campaign_id: String(36), NOT NULL, UNIQUE
- total_applications: Integer, default=0
- accepted_applications: Integer, default=0
- total_submissions: Integer, default=0
- approved_submissions: Integer, default=0
- total_spent: Numeric(12, 2), default=0
- total_budget: Numeric(12, 2), default=0
- avg_review_time_hours: Float, nullable
- Use TimestampMixin only (no SoftDeleteMixin — analytics records are never deleted)
- Index on campaign_id

### Schemas (`app/schemas/settlement.py`)
- SettlementCreate: campaign_id (str), creator_id (str), amount (float, gt=0), description (str | None)
- SettlementResponse: all Settlement fields, from_attributes=True
- AnalyticsResponse: all CampaignAnalytics fields, from_attributes=True
- AnalyticsUpdate: all analytics fields optional (for partial updates)

### Repository (`app/repositories/settlement_repo.py`)
- SettlementRepository: get_by_id, list_by_campaign (with pagination + status filter), list_by_creator (with pagination), create, update_status
- AnalyticsRepository: get_by_campaign_id, upsert (create-or-update by campaign_id), create

### Service Layer (`app/services/settlement_service.py`)
- create_settlement: validate amount > 0, set status=pending
- process_settlement: transition pending -> processing (ConflictError if not pending)
- complete_settlement: transition processing -> completed, set processed_at (ConflictError if not processing)
- fail_settlement: transition processing -> failed (ConflictError if not processing)
- list_settlements_by_campaign, list_settlements_by_creator (with pagination)
- get_campaign_analytics: return analytics for a campaign (NotFoundError if not found)
- update_analytics: upsert analytics record with new values

### API Endpoints (`app/api/v1/settlements.py`)
- POST /settlements — create settlement (admin only via require_role)
- GET /settlements — list settlements (query params: campaign_id, creator_id, status, pagination)
- GET /settlements/{id} — get settlement detail
- POST /settlements/{id}/process — start processing (admin only)
- POST /settlements/{id}/complete — mark completed (admin only)
- POST /settlements/{id}/fail — mark failed (admin only)
- GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/analytics — get analytics for campaign
- PUT /campaigns/{campaign_id}/analytics — update analytics (admin only)

Use _get_service() factory pattern as in the User API.

### Router Registration (`app/api/v1/router.py`)
- Add settlements router to the API router

### Model Registration (`app/models/__init__.py`)
- Export Settlement and CampaignAnalytics models

## Instructions
1. Explore the existing codebase to understand the project structure, conventions, and patterns used
2. Implement the required changes following the existing codebase conventions
3. Ensure your implementation matches the technical specification
4. Run existing tests to make sure nothing is broken
5. Your changes should be minimal — only modify what's necessary

Do NOT modify any existing test files. New test files will be added separately to verify your implementation.

## Required API Contract
The tests verify the following interfaces — use these exact names and paths:

### Routes
- `POST /api/v1/settlements` — create settlement with `campaign_id`, `creator_id`, `amount`, `currency`
- `GET /api/v1/settlements/{id}` — get settlement, returns 404 with `{"error": "..."}` if not found
- `POST /api/v1/settlements/{id}/process` — mark as processing, sets `processed_at`
- `POST /api/v1/settlements/{id}/complete` — mark as completed
- `POST /api/v1/settlements/{id}/fail` — mark as failed
- `GET /api/v1/campaigns/{id}/analytics` — returns analytics object

### Response Fields
Settlement objects must include: `id`, `campaign_id`, `creator_id`, `amount`, `currency`, `status`, `processed_at`
Analytics response must include: `total_budget`, `total_spent`, `total_applications`, `accepted_applications`, `total_submissions`, `avg_review_time_hours`
List endpoints return: `{"items": [...], "total": <int>}`

+import enum
+
+from sqlalchemy import DateTime, Float, Index, Integer, Numeric, String

+
+from app.models.base import Base, SoftDeleteMixin, TimestampMixin, generate_uuid
+
+
+class SettlementStatus(enum.Enum):
+    PENDING = "pending"
+    PROCESSING = "processing"
+    COMPLETED = "completed"
+    FAILED = "failed"
+
+
+class Settlement(Base, TimestampMixin, SoftDeleteMixin):
+    __tablename__ = "settlements"
+
+    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    campaign_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), nullable=False)
+    creator_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), nullable=False)
+    amount: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(12, 2), nullable=False)
+    currency: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(3), default="CNY", nullable=False)
+    status: Mapped[SettlementStatus] = mapped_column(nullable=False)
+    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(500), nullable=True)
+    processed_at: Mapped[None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
+
+    __table_args__ = (
+        Index("ix_settlements_campaign_id", "campaign_id"),
+        Index("ix_settlements_creator_id", "creator_id"),
+        Index("ix_settlements_status", "status"),
+    )
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"<Settlement {self.id} ({self.status.value})>"
+
+
+class CampaignAnalytics(Base, TimestampMixin):
+    __tablename__ = "campaign_analytics"
+
+    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    campaign_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), unique=True, nullable=False)
+    total_applications: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0, nullable=False)
+    accepted_applications: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0, nullable=False)
+    total_submissions: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0, nullable=False)
+    approved_submissions: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0, nullable=False)
+    total_spent: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(12, 2), default=0, nullable=False)
+    total_budget: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(12, 2), default=0, nullable=False)
+    avg_review_time_hours: Mapped[float | None] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=True)
+
+    __table_args__ = (
+        Index("ix_campaign_analytics_campaign_id", "campaign_id"),
+    )
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"<CampaignAnalytics campaign={self.campaign_id}>"

+from sqlalchemy import func, select
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
+
+from app.models.settlement import CampaignAnalytics, Settlement, SettlementStatus
+
+
+class SettlementRepository:
+    def __init__(self, db: AsyncSession) -> None:
+        self.db = db
+
+    async def get_by_id(self, settlement_id: str) -> Settlement | None:
+        query = select(Settlement).where(
+            Settlement.id == settlement_id, Settlement.is_deleted.is_(False)
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def list_by_campaign(
+        self,
+        campaign_id: str,
+        status: SettlementStatus | None = None,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> tuple[list[Settlement], int]:
+        query = select(Settlement).where(
+            Settlement.campaign_id == campaign_id, Settlement.is_deleted.is_(False)
+        )
+        count_query = (
+            select(func.count())
+            .select_from(Settlement)
+            .where(Settlement.campaign_id == campaign_id, Settlement.is_deleted.is_(False))
+        )
+
+        if status is not None:
+            query = query.where(Settlement.status == status)
+            count_query = count_query.where(Settlement.status == status)
+
+        total_result = await self.db.execute(count_query)
+        total = total_result.scalar_one()
+
+        query = query.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        settlements = list(result.scalars().all())
+
+        return settlements, total
+
+    async def list_by_creator(
+        self,
+        creator_id: str,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> tuple[list[Settlement], int]:
+        query = select(Settlement).where(
+            Settlement.creator_id == creator_id, Settlement.is_deleted.is_(False)
+        )
+        count_query = (
+            select(func.count())
+            .select_from(Settlement)
+            .where(Settlement.creator_id == creator_id, Settlement.is_deleted.is_(False))
+        )
+
+        total_result = await self.db.execute(count_query)
+        total = total_result.scalar_one()
+
+        query = query.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        settlements = list(result.scalars().all())
+
+        return settlements, total
+
+    async def create(self, settlement: Settlement) -> Settlement:
+        self.db.add(settlement)
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(settlement)
+        return settlement
+
+    async def update_status(self, settlement: Settlement) -> Settlement:
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(settlement)
+        return settlement
+
+
+class AnalyticsRepository:
+    def __init__(self, db: AsyncSession) -> None:
+        self.db = db
+
+    async def get_by_campaign_id(self, campaign_id: str) -> CampaignAnalytics | None:
+        query = select(CampaignAnalytics).where(
+            CampaignAnalytics.campaign_id == campaign_id
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def create(self, analytics: CampaignAnalytics) -> CampaignAnalytics:
+        self.db.add(analytics)
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(analytics)
+        return analytics
+
+    async def upsert(
+        self, campaign_id: str, updates: dict
+    ) -> CampaignAnalytics:
+        analytics = await self.get_by_campaign_id(campaign_id)
+        if analytics is None:
+            analytics = CampaignAnalytics(campaign_id=campaign_id, **updates)
+            self.db.add(analytics)
+        else:
+            for field, value in updates.items():
+                setattr(analytics, field, value)
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(analytics)
+        return analytics

+import math
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+from app.models.settlement import CampaignAnalytics, Settlement, SettlementStatus
+from app.repositories.settlement_repo import AnalyticsRepository, SettlementRepository
+from app.schemas.common import PaginatedResponse
+from app.schemas.settlement import (
+    AnalyticsResponse,
+    AnalyticsUpdate,
+    SettlementCreate,
+    SettlementResponse,
+)
+from app.utils.exceptions import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
+
+
+class SettlementService:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        settlement_repo: SettlementRepository,
+        analytics_repo: AnalyticsRepository,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.settlement_repo = settlement_repo
+        self.analytics_repo = analytics_repo
+
+    async def create_settlement(self, data: SettlementCreate) -> SettlementResponse:
+        if data.amount <= 0:
+            raise ValidationError("Settlement amount must be greater than 0")
+
+        settlement = Settlement(
+            campaign_id=data.campaign_id,
+            creator_id=data.creator_id,
+            amount=data.amount,
+            description=data.description,
+            status=SettlementStatus.PENDING,
+        )
+        settlement = await self.settlement_repo.create(settlement)
+        return SettlementResponse.model_validate(settlement)
+
+    async def get_settlement(self, settlement_id: str) -> SettlementResponse:
+        settlement = await self.settlement_repo.get_by_id(settlement_id)
+        if settlement is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Settlement", settlement_id)
+        return SettlementResponse.model_validate(settlement)
+
+    async def process_settlement(self, settlement_id: str) -> SettlementResponse:
+        settlement = await self.settlement_repo.get_by_id(settlement_id)
+        if settlement is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Settlement", settlement_id)
+        if settlement.status != SettlementStatus.PENDING:
+            raise ConflictError(
+                "Settlement", "status", settlement.status.value
+            )
+        settlement.status = SettlementStatus.PROCESSING
+        settlement = await self.settlement_repo.update_status(settlement)
+        return SettlementResponse.model_validate(settlement)
+
+    async def complete_settlement(self, settlement_id: str) -> SettlementResponse:
+        settlement = await self.settlement_repo.get_by_id(settlement_id)
+        if settlement is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Settlement", settlement_id)
+        if settlement.status != SettlementStatus.PROCESSING:
+            raise ConflictError(
+                "Settlement", "status", settlement.status.value
+            )
+        settlement.status = SettlementStatus.COMPLETED
+        settlement.processed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+        settlement = await self.settlement_repo.update_status(settlement)
+        return SettlementResponse.model_validate(settlement)
+
+    async def fail_settlement(self, settlement_id: str) -> SettlementResponse:
+        settlement = await self.settlement_repo.get_by_id(settlement_id)
+        if settlement is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Settlement", settlement_id)
+        if settlement.status != SettlementStatus.PROCESSING:
+            raise ConflictError(
+                "Settlement", "status", settlement.status.value
+            )
+        settlement.status = SettlementStatus.FAILED
+        settlement = await self.settlement_repo.update_status(settlement)
+        return SettlementResponse.model_validate(settlement)
+
+    async def list_settlements_by_campaign(
+        self,
+        campaign_id: str,
+        status: str | None = None,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> PaginatedResponse[SettlementResponse]:
+        status_enum = SettlementStatus(status) if status else None
+        settlements, total = await self.settlement_repo.list_by_campaign(
+            campaign_id=campaign_id, status=status_enum, page=page, page_size=page_size
+        )
+        return PaginatedResponse[SettlementResponse](
+            items=[SettlementResponse.model_validate(s) for s in settlements],
+            total=total,
+            page=page,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
+        )
+
+    async def list_settlements_by_creator(
+        self,
+        creator_id: str,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> PaginatedResponse[SettlementResponse]:
+        settlements, total = await self.settlement_repo.list_by_creator(
+            creator_id=creator_id, page=page, page_size=page_size
+        )
+        return PaginatedResponse[SettlementResponse](
+            items=[SettlementResponse.model_validate(s) for s in settlements],
+            total=total,
+            page=page,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
+        )
+
+    async def get_campaign_analytics(
+        self, campaign_id: str
+    ) -> AnalyticsResponse:
+        analytics = await self.analytics_repo.get_by_campaign_id(campaign_id)
+        if analytics is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("CampaignAnalytics", campaign_id)
+        return AnalyticsResponse.model_validate(analytics)
+
+    async def update_analytics(
+        self, campaign_id: str, data: AnalyticsUpdate
+    ) -> AnalyticsResponse:
+        updates = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+        analytics = await self.analytics_repo.upsert(campaign_id, updates)
+        return AnalyticsResponse.model_validate(analytics)

+    settlement_id = create_resp.json()["id"]
+
+    # Process it (pending -> processing)
+    await client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/settlements/{settlement_id}/process",
+        headers={"X-User-Id": sample_admin.id},
+    )
+
+    # Complete it (processing -> completed)
+    await client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/settlements/{settlement_id}/complete",
+        headers={"X-User-Id": sample_admin.id},
+    )
+
+    # Try to process again (completed -> should fail)
+    response = await client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/settlements/{settlement_id}/process",
+        headers={"X-User-Id": sample_admin.id},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 409
